theorems.name: Submission.indCompact_mollCauchy_l1_error
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Rn N)) (ρ : Rn N → ℝ) (σ R C : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet F volume → Continuous ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ρ y) → ∫ y, ρ y = 1 → Function.support ρ ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Rn N) σ → 0 ≤ C → (∀ h : Rn N, ‖h‖ ≤ σ → volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R ∩ symmDiff ((fun y ↦ y + h) ⁻¹' F) F) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖)) → ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R, ENNReal.ofReal |(∫ z in F, ρ (y - z)) - F.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) y| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (σ * C)
